profile.text: Operator Figurino, real name Luchino de Montano, is the current owner of the famous Tailor de Montano shop in Siracusa. The Siracusa branch sent him to Rhodes Island on an exchange tour. During his stay on the ship, he was temporarily assigned to the Logistics Department to provide various types of support to Rhodes Island.
